name: Voidek SERP Schema Builder – Schema & SEO Optimization Plugin
author: Voidek Webolutions

sections.description:
Voidek SERP Schema Builder adds valid JSON-LD structured data to your website to improve search visibility, enhance SERP appearance, and increase click-through rates.

Perfect for WooCommerce stores, blogs, and product-based sites, this plugin enables Google & AI tools to better understand your content and generate rich results like ratings, prices, author, stock status & more.
Supports Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)
through rich schema markup that helps AI answer engines better understand and use your content.

🔍 Why Choose Voidek SERP Schema Builder?

  • Instantly add Product, Review, and Article Schema.
  • Optimized for SEO & Core Web Vitals — lightweight and fast.
  • Improves Google Rich Results (stars, prices, author, publisher).
  • Enhances AI visibility — your structured data becomes usable for AI/LLM-generated answers.
  • Compatible with major SEO plugins like Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO.

🧠 How It Helps SEO

Structured data tells search engines what your content means, not just what it says. Valid schema increases trust, indexing accuracy and makes pages eligible for rich snippets and AI response extraction.

Your pages can appear with:
– ⭐ Product ratings and reviews
– 💰 Price and stock availability
– 🧑‍💻 Author, publisher, and headline for articles
– 📰 Rich snippets on Google and Bing
– 🧠 AI/AEO ready structured markup

Features

✅ Dynamic WooCommerce Product Schema
✅ Automatic Stock & Variation Updates
✅ Multi-image Product Support
✅ Review & Aggregate Ratings Schema
✅ Article Schema with Author & Publisher Info
✅ Structured Data Validation Ready
✅ Fast, Lightweight, and Developer-Friendly
✅ Full Admin Control for Schema Settings
✅ Supports AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)

✅ Helps AI answer engines understand your content
sections.installation:
1. Upload and activate the plugin from the WordPress ‘Plugins’ screen.
  2. Go to Voidek SERP Schema Builder in your dashboard.
  3. Configure your schema options and save changes.
sections.faq:
What is Schema Markup?

Schema (from schema.org) helps search engines understand the meaning behind your content. It makes your products, reviews, and articles eligible for rich results.

How does it help SEO?

It enhances visibility by adding structured data that increases CTR (click-through rate) and improves ranking signals to search engines.

Is it compatible with SEO plugins?

Yes — 100% compatible with Yoast SEO, Rank Math, and All in One SEO.

Will it slow down my site?

No. It’s designed to be lightweight, optimized, and free from unnecessary database queries.
